turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: Returns had the highest objection rate in September 2026, at 72.7 % of labelled calls (1 to 30 September 2026; a model-derived label). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
